notes.title: Parry!
notes.notes:
Combat Update:
New Parry Mechanic added (Click Attack button to Parry a melee attack)
Block/Defend now reduce damage by half


Other Fixes:
Minor bug fixes
Updated UI for Parry info

notes.title: Options/Settings
notes.notes:
Added a simple Options/Settings Menu to the game
-Volume
-Resolution
-Graphics Quality

notes.title: Demo Rework and Update
notes.notes:
Major Rework of the Demo/Intro
[list]
[*] New Start Area/Tutorial
[*] Changes to Start of the game
[*] Weaknesses/Resistances for enemies
[*] Boss Intros
[*] Sewer reworked some to now take into account the weakness/resistances 
[*] Sewer now dark
[*] Torches added for in and out of combat
[*] The Farm is no longer accessible in the Demo
[*] New Character menu to view inventory - Press C to view
[*] Various Bug Fixes
[/list]

I will be working on some more changes to the Demo/Intro here soon and another update will come in March. This will add more cutscenes/story elements to the game.

Thank you for playing the demo and wishlisting the game!

-Kurock

notes.title: Updated Demo Performance
notes.notes:
[list]

Thanks
Kurock

notes.title: Pix Souls First Alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
Greetings All!

The first Playtest of Pix Souls is now available!
You will be able to play through most of the first Chapter of the game for free! Starting today and running until November 10th.

It is currently a very early alpha build but I tried my best to get out all game breaking bugs so it would be playable :)

This is not a final product and is meant to be used as a starting build to see what you all think of the game. If you have any bug reports or feedback please post it in the Discussion Thread "Feedback/Bug Reports" on the Pix Souls store page. I will do my best to keep testing and fixing bug reports as they come in so you can play more. There is currently a way for player to start at different locations in the game so if you encounter a game breaking bug you dont have to start all over :)

Have fun testing the game and please let me know what you think!

Thank you :)
-Kurock


IF you want to test out the controller here is a rough mapping image. It should all work but the input is set to show keyboard/mouse.
